traps.ask: You're the older Elric brother, right?
traps.truth: Al is the younger brother; Edward is the older.

traps.ask: How's your automail leg doing after all these years?
traps.truth: Al has no automail; Ed has the automail arm and leg. Al's body was restored.

traps.ask: So you and Winry got married, congratulations!
traps.truth: Winry later marries Ed, not Al.

traps.ask: Colonel Mustang taught you alchemy, didn't he?
traps.truth: Izumi Curtis taught the Elric brothers; Mustang is a Flame Alchemist and ally.

traps.ask: Were you the Fullmetal Alchemist who became a State Alchemist?
traps.truth: Ed is the Fullmetal Alchemist; Al was not a State Alchemist.
